plugin.name: Harsh economy — recommended
plugin.description: Multiplies the monetary part of every reward by 0.75. Reputation rewards are unchanged. Intended for slower and harsher GAMMA progression.

plugin.name: Moderate economy
plugin.description: Uses the documented base payments without an additional multiplier. Better suited to a faster playthrough.

group.name: Choose the quest types to install

plugin.name: Patrol Contracts — 8 quests
plugin.description: Short and medium firefights at dynamically selected positions: roadblocks, ambushes, columns, veteran squads and deep raids. Up to two active quests with a shared 12-hour in-game cooldown.

plugin.name: Assault Operations — 4 quests
plugin.description: Agroprom, Dark Valley, Army Warehouses and Dead City. Clear the actual current garrison, then recover its documents. The base must repopulate before the quest can repeat. One active assault with a shared three-day in-game cooldown.

plugin.name: Defend the Line — 3 quests
plugin.description: Defend Rostok from mutants arriving through Garbage, a bandit raid or a Monolith breakthrough from the Barrier. Spawned waves are cleaned up when a quest is abandoned. One active defense with a shared two-day in-game cooldown.

plugin.name: Scientific Expeditions — 5 quests
plugin.description: Trips into X-16 and X-18, a reference artifact, rare mutant biology and a series of field measurements. Up to two active quests with a shared one-day in-game cooldown.

plugin.name: Field Work — 4 quests
plugin.description: Route surveys, medical supplies, a missing courier and clearing a mutant nest. Less gunfire, modest payment, up to two active quests and an eight-hour in-game cooldown.
